events.name: Detroit Lions at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.shortLinkText: Lions spoil Chiefs' celebration of Super Bowl title by rallying for a 21-20 win in the NFL's opener

Cincinnati Bengals at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — The Cleveland Browns took Ja'Marr Chase's trash talk personally.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson runs for TD, Browns bottle up Joe Burrow in 24-3 win over Bengals in season opener

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Tank Bigsby had the perfect response for his rookie mistake.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bigsby makes amends for big mistake by helping Jags earn rare 31-21 victory at Indy

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Minnesota Vikings
Tennessee Titans at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — After taking four sacks, throwing an interception and being flattened by a forearm to the face, a sore but determined Derek Carr pulled out the kind of finish he wanted in his New Orleans Saints debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derek Carr's New Orleans debut is a success as the Saints edge the Titans 16-15

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy spent months rehabbing his surgically repaired right elbow and an entire training camp wondering if he could regain the magic he...
headlines.shortLinkText: Purdy throws 2 TDs in return from elbow surgery; 49ers drill Steelers 30-7 in season opener

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Throughout the second half, Montez Sweat looked around at his defensive teammates and asked who was going to be the closer the Washington Commanders needed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Washington's defense takes over to help the Commanders rally past the Cardinals 20-16

events.name: Houston Texans at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — With J.K. Dobbins lost for the season because of a torn Achilles tendon, the Baltimore Ravens are again facing some major questions about...
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens beat Texans 25-9, but will be without running back J.K. Dobbins for the rest of the season

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Jordan Love kept telling himself he and his teammates were going to play great. He imagined how it would feel to leave the field with a win, too.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love delivers in opener, throws 3 TD passes as Packers beat Bears 38-20

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Change the coaches and switch the quarterbacks, the Raiders still own the Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Garoppolo and Meyers spoil Payton's Denver debut in Raiders' 7th straight win over Broncos

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts walked off the field following the Eagles' season-opening victory unsure of what the offense he leads can achieve this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts, Eagles build early lead, hang on to beat Patriots 25-20 as Tom Brady is honored

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Tua Tagovailoa might have shocked some observers by putting up one of the best passing days in an opener in NFL history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hill, Tagovailoa too much for Chargers as Dolphins open with 36-34 victory

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Matthew Stafford started the season without his favorite target, with a rebuilt and unproven offensive line, and with an outside narrative that the ceiling for the Los Angeles Rams this season is just being competitive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams show they can be more than competitive and thump Seahawks 30-13 in season opener

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: — The Dallas Cowboys have not only put some distance between themselves and the New York Giants in the NFC East, they showed Sunday night they are going to be a contender for more than a division title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys rip error-prone Giants 40-0 for worst shutout loss in the series between NFC East rivals

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: — The New York Jets pulled off one of their most exciting and unlikely victories in years — and still couldn't completely enjoy it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets lose Aaron Rodgers to an Achilles tendon injury, then rally to stun Bills 22-16 in overtime

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts forced a throw into double coverage, one of his worst passes in years, and was picked off. A.J. Brown — he of the nearly 1,500 yards receiving a year ago — threw a tantrum on the sidelines when the ball didn't come his way.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts runs for 2 TDs, throws for a score; Eagles hold off fumble-prone Vikings 34-28

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — When Arthur Smith sent the word to his offense — we're going for it on fourth down — the Atlanta Falcons were fired up.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robinson shines, Koo kicks winning field goal as Falcons rally past Packers 25-24

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — The worse Josh Allen feels one week, the better he plays the next.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen and the Bills bounce back from a season-opening dud with 38-10 rout of the Las Vegas Raiders

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson did more than enough to beat the Bengals, even without injured running back J.K. Dobbins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson, Ravens hold on to beat Cincinnati 27-24. Bengals 0-2 for second straight year

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Geno Smith, Tyler Lockett and the Seattle Seahawks showed their <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Geno Smith's 2nd TD pass to Tyler Lockett lifts the Seahawks to a 37-31 OT win over the Lions

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The Tennessee Titans finally got a much-needed sigh of relief.
headlines.shortLinkText: Folk's OT field goal in rain helps Titans snap 8-game skid with 27-24 win over Chargers

events.name: Chicago Bears at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield is determined to make the most of an opportunity to jump-start his NFL career with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield shines again, Buccaneers stay unbeaten with 27-17 victory over struggling Bears

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs insist they're fine despite another lackluster offensive effort.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs overcome mistakes to beat Jaguars 17-9, Kansas City's 3rd win vs. Jacksonville in 10 months

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — Indianapolis quarterback Anthony Richardson played a bit more than one quarter Sunday against the Houston Texans before departing because of a concussion.
headlines.shortLinkText: Richardson scores twice before leaving with concussion as Colts beat Texans 31-20

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — More than a few San Francisco 49ers acknowledged they didn't know a whole lot about many of the unsung players going against them for the rebuilding Los Angeles Rams.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers force 2 late turnovers and hold on for a 30-23 rivalry victory over the LA Rams

events.name: New York Giants at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — On the first play of the second half, New York quarterback Daniel Jones dropped back and heaved a 58-yard completion to rookie Jalin Hyatt over the middle of the field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daniel Jones throws for 321 yards, Giants rally from 21-point deficit to beat Cardinals 31-28

events.name: New York Jets at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — CeeDee Lamb went into the home opener for the Cowboys without new sidekick Brandin Cooks, who injured a knee in his Dallas debut a week earlier.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott has 2 TDs, Wilson 3 picks in 1st start after Rodgers injury as Cowboys beat Jets 30-10

events.name: Washington Commanders at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Washington cornerback Benjamin St-Juste didn't flinch after Brandon Johnson snared Russell Wilson's 50-yard Hail Mary touchdown pass off a double deflection with no time...
headlines.shortLinkText: Howell leads big rally for Commanders, who hold on to beat Broncos after Wilson's Hail Mary

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Tua Tagovailoa has heard a lot during his NFL career about his shortcomings. Beating the New England Patriots isn't one of them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mostert runs for 2 TDs, Tagovailoa throws for another as Dolphins hold off Patriots 24-17

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Tony Jones Jr. is making the most of his elevation from the Saints' practice squad, while Chris Olave continues to make plays for unbeaten New Orleans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tony Jones Jr. scores twice, Saints' defense shuts down Panthers' Bryce Young in 20-17 win

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — T.J. Watt and Alex Highsmith knew what was coming. Maybe the Cleveland Browns should have, too. It's the same thing that always seems to be coming when they visit Pittsburgh in the regular season.
headlines.shortLinkText: T.J. Watt's scoop-and-score lifts Steelers past Browns 26-22 as Cleveland loses Nick Chubb to injury

events.name: New York Giants at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — The New York Giants kept dialing up blitzes and the San Francisco 49ers just got the ball into their playmakers' hands.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian McCaffrey and the 49ers win 13th straight in the regular season, beat the Giants 30-12

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Nick Chubb's season-ending injury didn't crush the Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Myles Garrett, Cleveland's defense devour Titans, Deshaun Watson has 2 TD passes in Browns' 27-3 win

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jared Goff faked a handoff, dropped back and lofted a pass to a stunningly open Sam LaPorta.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws and runs for TDs, helping the Lions bounce back with a 20-6 win over Falcons

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Jordan Love celebrated his first career start at Lambeau Field by producing the type of comeback his four-time MVP predecessor orchestrated so often.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love rallies Packers to 18-17 win after Saints lose Derek Carr to shoulder injury

events.name: Denver Broncos at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — De’Von Achane could hear the crowd at Hard Rock Stadium chanting “Three more points!” on Miami’s final drive. The Dolphins had the ball inside the Denver Broncos’ 30 with less than a minute left, and they were three points shy of breaking the NFL’s...
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins rout Broncos 70-20, scoring the most points by an NFL team in a game since 1966

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — The Minnesota Vikings again lacked the late-game touch that was so golden for them last season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herbert, Chargers keep Vikings winless, pulling out a 28-24 victory sealed by late pick in end zone

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Mac Jones and the New England Patriots were off to a frustrating start to the season, falling just short of victories in their first two games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots beat Jets 15-10 to extend their winning streak to 15 straight over New York

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Josh Allen was still feeling fresh after the Buffalo Bills <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen throws for a TD, runs for another as the Bills rout the Commanders 37-3

events.name: Houston Texans at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Andrew Beck craned his neck after crossing the goal line, checking for penalty flags before celebrating.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beck's rare TD return propels Texans to a 37-17 rout of Jaguars and gives Ryans his first win

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — It's not often a kicker manages to upstage Justin Tucker.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matt Gay kicks 4 FGs over 50 yards, including OT winner, as Colts beat Ravens 22-19

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — On the weekend the Seattle Seahawks honored their past, their performance on the field looked like the height of their run a decade ago.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenneth Walker III sparks Seahawks in second half as Seattle pulls away to beat Carolina 37-27

events.name: Chicago Bears at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Travis Kelce was chatting with Patrick Mahomes in practice this week when he mentioned, almost as an afterthought, that he thought Taylor Swift would take him up on his invitation to watch the Kansas City Chiefs play the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes throws 3 TD passes, Taylor Swift celebrates as Chiefs rout Bears 41-10

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Nearly an hour after his first NFL win as a starter, Arizona Cardinals quarterback Joshua Dobbs walked through the locker room with the game ball still securely tucked in his left arm.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joshua Dobbs, James Conner lead the Cardinals to a 28-16 win over the mistake-prone Cowboys

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Even picking up first downs was a challenge for Pittsburgh's offense in the first two games, so much so that fans loudly chanted for a change in the offensive coordinator.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenny Pickett passes for 2 touchdowns as Pittsburgh Steelers top Las Vegas Raiders 23-18

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts and the Philadelphia Eagles are unbeaten, but not perfect or even as good as they feel they can be.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts throws for TD, runs for another as Eagles thump Buccaneers 25-11 to remain unbeaten

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — After missing most of training camp with a calf injury, Joe Burrow is still working his way back into form.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burrow shakes off calf injury, throws for a season-high 259 yards as Bengals beat the Rams 19-16

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — David Montgomery never beat the Green Bay Packers during his four seasons with the Chicago Bears.
headlines.shortLinkText: David Montgomery runs wild as Lions beat Packers 34-20 to take early command of NFC North
